verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page documents Privacy Mode. Any user (free or Pro) can enable it in settings, or a team or enterprise admin can enforce it, and new team members inherit the team setting. Cursor states that when it is enabled, it will not train on your data. Bugbot is a Cursor product tied to the same account, so this control reasonably applies to it, but no source explicitly confirms that. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Privacy Mode covers Bugbot's PR-review data, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training guarantee.
